findings.claim: The new test's geometry() writes its own heading formula and angle wrap instead of using `headingOf` and `wrapAngle` from `src/sim/vec.ts`. Other tests already import those two helpers directly (tests/sim/helpers.ts:14, tests/sim/track.test.ts:23).
findings.evidence: tests/content/hay-loop.test.ts:19 `return Math.atan2(bx - ax, -(bz - az));` is exactly `headingOf(bx - ax, bz - az)` (src/sim/vec.ts:19-21: `return Math.atan2(dx, -dz);`). Line 26 `Math.atan2(Math.sin(d), Math.cos(d))` wraps the turn delta into (−π, π], which is what `wrapAngle(d)` does (src/sim/vec.ts:10). The only difference is at exactly −π, where atan2 returns π and wrapAngle also returns π, so results match.
findings.suggestedFix: In tests/content/hay-loop.test.ts, add `import { headingOf, wrapAngle } from '../../src/sim/vec.ts';`. Then replace line 19 with `return headingOf(bx - ax, bz - az);` and line 26 with `turned.push((turned[i - 1] as number) + wrapAngle(d));`.
